Pentest Harness provides a self-hosted AI agent workspace for authorized penetration tests, bug bounty research, and CTFs. It uses JSONL and SQLite to persist local sessions with full replay support. Built on the Cordis plugin architecture, every layer from model adapters to tools is fully configurable.
